title: wafa jiska padhe kalma
body:
Wafa Jiska Padhe Kalma use Abbas Kehte Hai
Jise Sajde Kare Sajdah use Abbas Kehte Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Pyasa Pyas Ne Jiski Kiya Sehrab Darya Ko
Hai Jis Ki Pyas Bhi Darya Use Abbas Kehte Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Hai Shabbir Ki quwwat Ali Ko Naaz Hi Jis Par
Jise Zehra Kahe Beta use Abbas Kehte Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Laga De Jo Bagair Tegh Hi Ambaar Lasho'n Ke
Jo Hai Paikar Shuja'at Ka use Abbas Kehte Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Patthar Par Alam Gade use Kehte Hai Sub Hyder
Alam Gade Jo Pani Pe use Abbas Kehte Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali Ka Khoon, Zehra (S.a.) Ki Dua Hasnain Ki Chahat
Bane In Sub Se Jo Milkar use Abbas Kehte Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Hukme Shaah Pe Roke Rahe Talwar Ko Apni
Jo Tanha Bhi Rahe Lashkar use Abbas Kehte Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Uthe Toofa'n Chale Aandhi Zamee'n Gardish Kare Phir Bhi
Rahe Uncha Alam Jiska use Abbas Kehte Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Tha Shabbir Ka qaadim Magar Sab Sahebaane Dil
use Aaqa, use Maula, use Abbas Kehte Hai
